events.title: Psychic Readings
events.description: Gather your friends for a pre-Halloween evening of psychic readings with Psychic Medium Janis Manacsa and Sound Practitioner Julie Kalua. Experience live gallery readings, opening and closing sound baths, and the mystery of the season. October 30, 6:30–9 p.m. at East West Bookshop. Limited to 20 guests.
events.blurb: Get a live gallery reading from a psychic medium and settle into sound baths with a sound practitioner.

events.title: Tech or Treat
events.address: The Tech Interactive, 201 S Market St, San Jose, CA 95113
events.description: Halloween at the museum with costumes, trick-or-treat stations, spooky science activities, photo ops and a slime workshop. Laser shows in the Dome Theater (Halloween Spooktacular at 4:30 and 5:15 p.m., Stranger Things at 6 p.m.) cost extra. Tickets are $38 for adults and $28 for children, seniors and students.
events.blurb: Trick-or-treat through the museum, try spooky science activities and a slime workshop, and pose for photos at The Tech Interactive's Halloween event.

events.title: Hiding in Plain Sight: Disability and Art History
events.address: NUMU (New Museum Los Gatos), Los Gatos (hybrid: in person or virtual)
events.description: Artist and UC Berkeley professor emerita Katherine Sherwood explores notable figures in art history through a disability lens and discusses contemporary disability arts. Free with registration; attend in person or online.
events.blurb: Hear artist and professor emerita Katherine Sherwood examine art history figures through a disability lens, in person or online with free registration.

events.title: Faculty Design Thinking Workshop
events.description: Join fellow faculty for a hands-on workshop, hosted by Cfeti and the Adobe Center of Excellence, that focuses on turning everyday teaching challenges into creative possibilities for student learning.
events.blurb: Work alongside fellow faculty in a hands-on workshop turning everyday teaching challenges into creative learning ideas, hosted by Cfeti and the Adobe Center of Excellence.

events.title: Santa Clara Sips Nyc
events.description: Join Santa Clara alumni and friends in NYC for drinks, good conversation, and a chance to meet your fellow Broncos. Come sip, mingle, and reconnect!
events.blurb: Meet fellow Santa Clara alumni and friends in New York over drinks and conversation at Gottino Enoteca e Salumeria.

events.title: Tricks, Treats & Trinkets
events.description: Free family-friendly Halloween event with local vendors, food trucks, coffee, and trick-or-treating. Costumes welcome.
events.blurb: Go trick-or-treating, browse local vendors, and grab food truck bites and coffee at this free, family-friendly Halloween event where costumes are welcome.
